frequency.FREQUENCY_RATE_INTERPRETATION_TEST_V1: Usual frequency ranges constrain expected completed sessions/week; not exact calendar-week counts.
frequency.CONTEXT_PARTITION_TEST_V1: Four charging contexts form a mutually exclusive, exhaustive partition; total rate equals their sum.
frequency.MONTH_CONVERSION_TEST_V1: Monthly usual rates multiply by 0.2299794661190965, using 365.25/12 days/month.
frequency.ENCODED_BOUNDARY_INTERPRETATION_V2: Numeric envelopes use interval closures. Forced points and generated draws are checked against encoded endpoint membership; excluded or unreviewed points are not sampled.
frequency.JOINT_RATE_SAMPLING_TEST_V1: Uniform feasible total, then shuffled context order and sequential uniform feasible allocations. This is not uniform over the joint polytope or a fitted joint distribution.

energy.OWNER_USUAL_ENERGY_V1: Each parameter draw represents an owner's latent usual session energy; it does not estimate within-owner session variation.
energy.OWNER_CONDITIONING_V1: Owner reporting intervals and frequency links are retained. Candidate families are conditioned on that owner's energy bounds.
energy.UNIFORM_BOUNDED_ENERGY_TEST_V1: Uniform positive energy inside a finite reported interval; open-upper answers remain deferred in this case.
energy.CONDITIONAL_ENERGY_FAMILY_TEST_V1: Pooled fitted Gamma/Lognormal shapes provide alternative within-interval/tail laws. Category frequencies remain those of retained owner records.
energy.COMMON_QUANTILES_TEST_V1: The same owner/draw quantile is used across supported energy cases. Energy and frequency draws are conditionally independent within the linked owner's constraints.

timing.TIMING_UNIFORM_WITHIN_REPORTED_WINDOW_V1: Continuous uniform timing inside each reported circular start window; not observed exact timestamps.

power.HOME_RANGE_PROXY_V1: Reported finite positive home ranges supply a uniform constant-power test proxy; actual delivered power is not measured.
power.NONHOME_POWER_V1: Existing rating weights and average/rated fractions are development assumptions conditional on the known charger type.
power.POWER_TEST_PAIRING_V1: Each owner/context/draw uses the same random stream across power cases. Home draws and selected non-home ratings are matched.
power.DRAW_INTERPRETATION_V1: These are sampler checks, not sessions. Future home equipment power is retained per owner realisation; non-home equipment/power is sampled per session.

limits: Component availability is not simulator eligibility, physical compatibility, empirical validation or approval to scale nationally.

The joined rows reuse saved parameter tests; they are not new owners, sessions, independent observations or demand replicates.

One usual-energy value and home-power value are retained per future owner realisation. Non-home power models remain per-session samplers.
Matching draw indices implements conditional-independent parameter streams within an owner; it does not estimate within-owner dependence.
